independentReview.summary: No concrete reachable P1/P2 found in the complete probe source and the gs-boundary additions to run-mac.py actually read. This is a bounded source review, not independent runtime acceptance. The report is finalized from the evidence already read, without further source exploration or execution.

sourcesAsActuallyRead.coverage: Complete current file was read, including numbered source.
Actual gs-boundary diff/additions and immediate invocation, mandatory cleanup and final acceptance context were read. Other runner functionality was not re-reviewed.

independentReview.snapshotBoundary: Hashes are the actual source snapshots returned by the last completed read. They were not rechecked after the user timebox instruction; this final tool only writes the report.

reviewEvidence.subject: Fiber validity and dereference guard
reviewEvidence.observation: fiber_state compares the API, read-only raw slot and TEB field with the expected live fiber. It fatally rejects null/mismatched state before GetFiberData dereferences the current fiber. Callback thread identity is checked before callback fiber observations.

reviewEvidence.subject: Valid fiber lifecycle
reviewEvidence.observation: Each case first requires a plain thread, converts successfully, creates a distinct child fiber, switches to it and returns to the main fiber before deleting the suspended child. Conversion back precedes the final IsThreadAFiber check and TLS clearing. GetCurrentFiber/GetFiberData are not used before conversion or after conversion back. The context remains live on the case stack throughout.

reviewEvidence.subject: LastError semantics
reviewEvidence.observation: API/raw/TEB error values are captured before logging. Explicit setters use known expected values. After Sleep, the sampled API value is used only for consistency; no undocumented preservation is asserted. The failed OPEN_EXISTING file call captures LastError before logging and separately requires ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND. LastError is not treated as fiber-local preserved state.

reviewEvidence.subject: Window, VEH and APC lifetime
reviewEvidence.observation: The window creation callback uses the supplied live context; the window is destroyed and its class unregistered before the case returns. The VEH filters its own continuable exception, obtains the current case through TLS, and is removed after the synchronous RaiseException returns. The self-thread APC is queued once and awaited in an alertable loop with one fixed five-second deadline; the callback completes before that loop returns. Unprovable callback completion terminates the process rather than returning past the context storage.

reviewEvidence.subject: Owned worker join
reviewEvidence.observation: The worker runs a separate case after the main case finishes. Its thread handle is joined with a five-second wait before exit-code inspection, handle close and TLS-index free. Failed join takes process-fatal containment, so it does not return past a live owned worker. This is a finite join attempt, not a standalone whole-program wall-time guarantee; mandatory suite cleanup remains required.

reviewEvidence.subject: Exact grouped inventory
reviewEvidence.observation: The validator requires exactly 108 check rows, literal ok:true, string role/name, integer actual/expected, actual==expected, and exact Counter equality over role/name pairs. Name/type checks precede Counter construction. The source-derived inventory is main 68, worker 34 and outer 6: common 10 + 12 fiber-state + 12 error-state checks per case, plus main-only 10 boundary-control and 24 callback-observation checks.

reviewEvidence.subject: New invocation and metadata branch
reviewEvidence.observation: gs-boundary selects gs-boundary-<arch>.exe, accepts correctness mode with no guest arguments, requires subject/mode gs-boundary/correctness, a positive integer pid and integer completion counts 108/0 with successful output flags. It applies valid_gs_checks and joins the mandatory owned-cleanup suite set.

reviewEvidence.subject: Mandatory runtime cleanup and acceptance
reviewEvidence.observation: The added cleanup membership makes ordinary success/failure enter stop-runtime as well as interruption. Acceptance requires the cleanup receipt with helper exit 0, confirmed GUI shutdown, no pending processes, at least two empty observations, and no unconfirmed client reap. The final active/wall clock check includes cleanup. Exit 0, metadata/check success and the existing final rejection gates remain required.
